ROOT_CAUSE: Product Case treated optional DB projections as fatal and its relay mapped every thrown error to 502. Critical queue resolution, optional package and optional active-listing enrichment formed a serial chain without a Product Case deadline; SDK retries were enabled. Source reads had no abort signal. Expected transient/slow DB failures could therefore destroy independently proven Luna truth or exceed MCP's 30-second deadline.
HISTORICAL_EXACT_FAILING_DEPENDENCY: UNPROVEN: previous deployed relay sanitized the original cause; no fabricated retrospective per-query timing.
OBSERVED_UPSTREAM_FAILURE: Direct existing DB Data API scope preflight returned HTTP 521 in this session. The underlying infrastructure producing 521 is not independently proven.
CODE_CHANGES: One request-local global budget; critical identity reads separately bounded; independent package/active reads concurrent.
Every source query scoped and capped, abortable including transfer, with retry(false). No portfolio pagination or new API authority.
Expected optional DB failures map to existing UNAVAILABLE field/stage semantics with explicit failure codes. Independent Luna truth and successful fallback authorities preserved.
Critical read failure returns an explicit UNAVAILABLE identity/truth envelope; no invented identity, empty success case, zero or false.
Unexpected programming errors rethrow, emit bounded safe diagnostics, and remain visible as application 500; not swallowed as missing evidence.
SUMMARY now retains all 25 canonical Luna fields alongside its existing selected downstream fields. Same durable Product Truth projector, classifications and values.
Added safe READ_DIAGNOSTICS for authority, latency, query count, HTTP/SQL classification, retry count and budget.
KNOWN_RESEARCH_SHIPPING_GAPS: Unchanged. No source acquisition, reclassification, inferred receipts or fabricated evidence.

INVARIANT: Same MCP/Tunnel services, authentication, protected Preview-only relay, 28-tool catalog and durable Product Truth. Optional unavailability cannot erase independent Luna field truth.
DETECTION_RULE: Inspect READ_DIAGNOSTICS by dependency/authority for timeout, SQL/HTTP error, skipped prerequisite or unexpected runtime exception.
RECOVERY_POLICY: A subsequent ordinary Product Case read can reacquire current durable evidence. No mutation, resubmit, new ledger, per-product dispatch or synthetic fallback.
RETRY_POLICY: No per-query client retry; each request settles or cancels within its scoped/per-case deadlines.
REGRESSION_GUARD: 15 focused Product Case tests plus seven existing suites and typecheck; nine Golden physical requests spanning all three modes.
OBSERVABILITY_RECEIPT: READ_DIAGNOSTICS plus this technical report; original business receipts not modified.
ESCALATION_POLICY: Critical identity unavailability is explicit and cannot become a fabricated case. Unexpected runtime exceptions remain HTTP 500 with safe diagnostics; do not label them optional missing evidence.
LIMITATIONS: Finite sequential sample establishes observed stability; it is not a guarantee against all future network/platform outages.
Prior failed Golden requests are retained as baseline history, not removed from certification records.
The direct HTTP521 observation proves a DB transport failure on that diagnostic path, not the precise origin of every earlier production incident.
Incremental I/O latency is zero for reused/non-executed authorities; CPU latency of each pure projection was not separately instrumented.
Summary now exposes all Luna fields without changing the underlying 25-field Product Truth semantics; downstream summary remains bounded.
